Political scientists argue that this shift signifies a move from the floor of Indian politics to the ceiling, where parties must build coalitions around broader issues like job creation and economic mobility.

recent_articles.title: Assembly election 2026 LIVE: Exit polls predict close contest in West Bengal, DMK+ lead in Tamil Nadu, - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Exit polls on Wednesday, April 29, 2026, indicated a clear majority for the **BJP** in Assam and an edge over the ruling **TMC** in West Bengal.  The polls also projected a return of the **DMK** government in Tamil Nadu and a comeback by the Congress-led UDF in Kerala after 10 years. All forecasts predicted a return to power for the AINRC-led NDA government in Puducherry. The counting of votes for all five assemblies will take place on May 4th.

recent_articles.title: How Tamil Nadu waited for Assembly election results over the decades - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The 10-day waiting period between Tamil Nadu's Assembly election on April 23 and the counting of votes on May 4 is relatively short compared to past elections.  **DMK**, which won the 1967 Madras State Legislative Assembly election after a delimitation exercise, saw a longer wait for results. The election was held in three phases with polling taking place on February 15, 18, and 21. However, only 233 seats were contested, and one constituency (Thirumangalam) had to be rescheduled due to a candidate's death.

recent_articles.title: Twist in gold theft at Sattur DMK candidate’s house: estranged daughter-in-law, accomplices arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **A. Kadarkarai Raj**, the DMK candidate for the Sattur Assembly constituency, had 122 sovereigns of gold jewelry stolen from his residence on April 13th.  The police arrested **Abhinaya**, the estranged elder daughter-in-law of Mr. Kadarkarai Raj, along with her partner, **Suresh Kumar** and **Bhavani**, as well as another couple who were involved in the crime. Twelve sovereigns of stolen property have been recovered. The police are still searching for the remaining suspects.

recent_articles.title: M.P. Assembly passes resolution to implement women’s reservation after delimitation amid uproar by Opposition - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Madhya Pradesh** Assembly passed a resolution to implement women's reservation following the delimitation exercise, despite opposition from the Congress.  **Chief Minister Mohan Yadav** proposed the resolution, urging immediate implementation after the completion of the delimitation process. The resolution was met with resistance from the Opposition, who argued that the government's actions contradicted its words and called for an immediate enforcement of the Women's Reservation Act.

recent_articles.title: Even as Tamil Nadu comes down from its election high, tensions are still rising - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tamil Nadu** voters cast record-breaking numbers in the April 23, 2026 election.  The period between polling and vote counting is marked by debate on various issues including **Chief Minister M.K.Stalin's** holiday plans and comparisons of the state's IT sector performance with other southern states. The presence of the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), led by actor C. Joseph Vijay, also raises questions about potential coalition governments.
